name: Protopasta Glass Fiber HTPETG @base
filament_notes:
Glass Fiber HTPETG (Highfive Blue, White).
Proto-Pasta publishes no numeric settings for this line; PETG-family defaults applied (250C@12 mm3/s, 80C plate). Stiff like PLA, durable like PETG, higher temperature resistance than GF PCTG.
Glass fiber is abrasive - hardened nozzle recommended. Use Magigoo or glue stick.
